name: Typhoon Hato (天鸽)
impactSummary: Typhoon Hato was the strongest typhoon to hit Macau in 53 years. It caused massive flooding across Macau Peninsula and Taipa, with significant damage to residential and commercial properties.

name: Typhoon Mangkhut (山竹)
impactSummary: Super Typhoon Mangkhut was one of the most powerful storms to affect Macau. It caused extensive flooding, particularly in low-lying coastal areas, with severe damage to infrastructure and properties.

name: Typhoon Ragasa (雷伽萨)
impactSummary: Typhoon Ragasa brought significant rainfall and storm surge to Macau, causing flooding in several districts. The event resulted in substantial property damage and business interruption.
